description: Source code for the AmqpClientActor class, which manages an AMQP 1.0 connection using the Qpid JMS client within an Akka actor system. It handles connection lifecycle, session recovery, and messaging components, delegating blocking operations to child actors.

classes.name: JmsConnect
classes.description: Message class for initiating a JMS connection, used internally within the actor system.

classes.name: JmsRecoverSession
classes.description: Message class for recovering a JMS session, including connection and session details.

classes.name: JmsCloseSession
classes.description: Message class for closing a JMS session.

classes.name: JmsDisconnect
classes.description: Message class for disconnecting a JMS connection.

classes.name: JmsConnected
classes.description: Response class indicating a successful JMS connection establishment, including connection, session, and consumers.

classes.name: JmsSessionRecovered
classes.description: Response class indicating a session has been recovered, including session and consumer list.

classes.name: JmsDisconnected
classes.description: Response class indicating a JMS disconnection.

classes.name: StatusReportingListener
classes.description: Listener class that updates connection status for metrics reporting, implementing JmsConnectionListener.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates actor Props for AmqpClientActor with connection and optional proxy and connection actors.

methods.name: propsForTests
methods.description: Creates actor Props for testing with injected JmsConnectionFactory.

methods.name: validateConnection
methods.description: Validates a Connection object by attempting to create a provider URI.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Cleans up JMS connection on actor termination.

methods.name: inConnectedState
methods.description: Defines behavior in the connected state, handling session recovery.

methods.name: inAnyState
methods.description: Defines behavior for various events in any actor state, including connection restoration and failure.

methods.name: doTestConnection
methods.description: Performs a test connection by delegating to a child actor and handling the response.

methods.name: doConnectClient
methods.description: Initiates a connection by delegating to a child actor.

methods.name: doDisconnectClient
methods.description: Disconnects a connection by delegating to a child actor.

methods.name: allocateResourcesOnConnection
methods.description: Allocates JMS connection and session resources upon successful connection.

methods.name: startPublisherActor
methods.description: Starts the publisher actor if JMS session is available.

methods.name: startConsumerActors
methods.description: Starts consumer actors based on the connected client data.

methods.name: cleanupResourcesForConnection
methods.description: Cleans up resources related to a connection, including stopping consumers and closing JMS connection.

methods.name: cleanupFurtherResourcesOnConnectionTimeout
methods.description: Kills connection handlers on timeout to prepare for next commands.

methods.name: isEventUpToDate
methods.description: Determines if an event is relevant based on current state and sender.

methods.name: getPublisherActor
methods.description: Returns the actor responsible for publishing messages.

methods.name: startCommandConsumers
methods.description: Starts consumer actors for given list of consumers.

methods.name: startCommandConsumer
methods.description: Starts a single consumer actor.

methods.name: stopCommandConsumers
methods.description: Stops all active consumer actors.

methods.name: getTestConnectionHandler
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the test connection handler actor.

methods.name: getConnectConnectionHandler
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the connect connection handler actor.

methods.name: getDisconnectConnectionHandler
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the disconnect connection handler actor.

methods.name: startConnectionHandlingActor
methods.description: Creates a connection handling actor with a specific suffix.

methods.name: ensureJmsConnectionClosed
methods.description: Closes the JMS connection asynchronously in an isolated dispatcher.

methods.name: recoverSession
methods.description: Attempts to recover a closed or invalid JMS session.

methods.name: handleSessionRecovered
methods.description: Handles successful session recovery, starting publisher and consumers.

methods.name: isRecoverSessionOnSessionClosedEnabled
methods.description: Checks if session recovery on session close is enabled in config.

methods.name: isRecoverSessionOnConnectionRestoredEnabled
methods.description: Checks if session recovery on connection restore is enabled in config.

methods.name: onException
methods.description: Handles JMS exceptions by logging and reporting.
